fnf-vs-touhou.title: FNF vs Touhou - Epic Musical Duel in Anime World
fnf-vs-touhou.slogan: Challenge the Touhou Universe with Rhythmic Beats!
fnf-vs-touhou.description: Immerse yourself in FNF vs Touhou, a thrilling musical duel set in the magical anime world of Touhou. Face off against powerful characters with mesmerizing rhythms and conquer the peak scores. With vibrant visuals and captivating music, this game offers an unforgettable experience. Ready to test your reflexes and musical skills? Play FNF vs Touhou now and embark on your journey to victory!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: FNF vs Touhou is a climactic musical duel inspired by the Touhou Project series. Enter a colorful anime world where cute characters possess both attractive appearances and excellent fighting techniques. With bright visuals and cool music, this game will keep you hooked for hours.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Play the role of Boyfriend and challenge powerful opponents.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Keep up with the notes to maintain the green score bar.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Win by retaining the green color on the score bar when the song ends.
